title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.35797v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. translated_title: 二值化使分数空间坍缩扁平
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）评审常被用作奖励信号，用于在确定性验证器无法覆盖的目标上训练策略。然而，这些奖励通常被坍缩为通过/不通过（{0, 1}），这只报告判定结果，却不反映回答在每条标准上的具体表现。我们将每个通过/不通过判定建模为某一未公开量表上的分数，并与单一截断阈值进行比较。对该量表的拉伸会按比例地将每个分数推向或推离截断点，但绝不会使其越过截断点，因此任何判定都不会改变。因此，策略可以自由地施加任意拉伸而不改变评审面板所报告的任何内容。在联合高斯模型下，引入第三个等级会添加第二个阈值，从而消除这种仿射拉伸带来的歧义。在一个七标准评审器对 MATH 和 SciBench 输出的实验中，所有 14 个构造的按标准拉伸在二值化后均不可见，但在三个等级下均可被检测到。在 n=1,024 时，给定两种总体规律的检验具有至少 96.5% 的功效。
tldr: 将LLM评审奖励二值化为通过/不通过会完全掩盖底层分数空间中的仿射拉伸信息，而引入第三个等级即可通过第二阈值消除这种歧义并恢复可检测的分数细节。
en_tdlr: Binarizing LLM-judge rewards into pass/fail renders any affine stretch of the underlying score space invisible, while introducing a third grade adds a second threshold that removes this ambiguity and restores detectable score information.
